name: GoPro Drone
notes: Geometry and mass properties imported from the original MATLAB/CAD model. Motor order FL, FR, RL, RR. Inertia is about the center of mass. Liftoff propulsion, drag and frame collisions remain the selected stock setup. Apply adds geometry-aware pitch/roll mixing and inertia-scaled controller gains while retaining stock input rates and simplified yaw. Geometry edits do not automatically recalculate mass properties.
